name: 2032 Calumet Avenue — Brick dwelling (district draft; refined by T-1946)

function.note: The 1911 sheet marks the building 'D' (dwelling): '3S.B. brick dwelling (D) on the 21st Street corner, a dashed inner line round its front block, a 3B rear part and a 2B piece on the north side, one-storey frame porches on the front, the north and the south, and a small frame box lettered on its roof'. research_note: A DISTRICT DRAFT (T-3018, the owner's district pass of 2026-10-08): a serviceable first model, complete from the street, the walks, the alley and the air, that T-1946 refines in place under this same id. documented_range.note: The draft claims the 1904 target and no more: the 1911 sheet draws the building and the T-3018 census rules it present in 1904 (present_as_mapped). Its building and loss dates are the per-building ticket's to read.

position.note: The rear corner of the main body's rectangle (lot frame u 33.250, v -11.750 m from the middle of the rear lot line), through the T-1250 fit of the sheet: the sheet's georeference carries no independent check: its own fit residual is 0.05 m RMS on its control crossings, a similarity on two degrees of freedom that says little away from them, plus about a pixel (0.19 m) of trace on this coarser copy.
